name: Frosted glass title pill
what: A frosted-glass pill over your picture or video: it starts low with its title blurred, shoots up to the middle with a small overshoot while the title comes into focus, holds as the glass catches a slow band of light, then rises a hair and drops back with a liquid wobble of its outline while the title blurs out again.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f10 the pill shoots up from low in the frame past its resting place (title blurred and dim, coming into focus f0-f18); f10-f34 it settles at the middle; it holds to f130 (a slow band of light crosses the glass); f130-f141 it rises a hair; f142-f149 it drops fast to where it started with a liquid wobble of its outline, the title blurring out (f142-f152); then it holds

tracks.name: pill rise
tracks.what: the pill shoots up from low in the frame, overshooting a little

tracks.name: pill settle
tracks.what: it eases down to the middle

tracks.name: title focus
tracks.what: the title comes into focus and brightens

tracks.name: sheen
tracks.what: a slow band of light crosses the glass

tracks.name: drop
tracks.what: it drops fast back to where it started, the outline wobbling like liquid

tracks.name: title blur
tracks.what: the title blurs out and dims
